description: Employer-specific professional evidence captured outside the canonical resume.

fields.requirement: tool, responsibility, process, domain skill, or qualification
fields.unsafe_wording: claims that would overstate the evidence

status_rules.CONFIRMED: May be used for JD matching and tailored resume generation when relevant, preserving employer mapping.
status_rules.REJECTED: Must not be used and should not be repeatedly asked unless the user explicitly revises the answer.
status_rules.PENDING: Must trigger a user confirmation question before professional use.
